exposure: clinicians' attitudes and beliefs about trial of labor after a cesarean (TOLAC)
trial of labor after a cesarean (TOLAC)
outcome: reasons for supporting or opposing TOLAC
cohort: 183 obstetricians in the Western Region of Saudi Arabia
finding: The majority of obstetricians (79.2%) were against offering TOLAC, and their views were influenced by both medical and non-medical factors.
mod_finding: The majority of obstetricians in the study (79.2%) were against offering trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC).
